item.title: Blit 1.0.6
item.description: Blit 1.0.6. To File (Go › To File…, ⇧⌘J): every download that hasn't been filed, in one list; Space previews, R renames with your naming preset, M moves to the suggested folder. Find in Archive (File › Find in Archive…, ⇧⌘F): find anything Blit has moved, by any name it had, even while the NAS is asleep. Photos: when a camera card goes in, Blit offers to import it into a folder per day on this Mac and back it up to the NAS; right-click a shoot folder › Back Up Edits to NAS… copies its DxO (.dop) and XMP edits next to the photos there. Also: an empty folder's disclosure triangle turns back when it's closed.
